properties.name: contexa.pqa.routes.official-api-root
properties.description: Canonical root for the OSS prompt-quality administration API.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.routes.enterprise-api-root
properties.description: Canonical root for the Enterprise prompt-quality administration API.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.routes.enterprise-verification-runtime-runs-path
properties.description: Path below the Enterprise API root for official verification runtime runs.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.official-verification.stale-execution-timeout
properties.description: Elapsed time without execution progress after which an interrupted official verification can be recovered by the next request.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.capture-enabled
properties.description: Whether the OSS decision pipeline seals the final LLM prompt and the enforced decision into sealed evidence packages. Ignored when contexa.enterprise.enabled is true.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.snapshot-ttl
properties.description: Maximum time a captured prompt trace waits in memory for the decision pipeline to seal it.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.max-pending-snapshots
properties.description: Upper bound of prompt traces kept in memory before Layer1 completion; the oldest are evicted first.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.max-completed-snapshots
properties.description: Upper bound of completed prompt traces kept in memory until they are sealed; the oldest are evicted first.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.retention.enabled
properties.description: Whether expired sealed evidence packages are deleted on schedule. Ignored when contexa.enterprise.enabled is true.

properties.name: contexa.pqa.oss.sealed-evidence.retention.cleanup-cron
properties.description: Cron expression of the cleanup that deletes sealed evidence packages whose expiresAt has passed.
